scientific_payload.context_block:
[Document 1]
Mailed survey asking about costs of 23 investigations and 23 therapies relevant to family practice. A random sample of 600 doctors was asked to report their awareness of costs and to estimate costs of the 46 items.

[Document 2]
To determine the cost of 46 commonly used investigations and therapies and to assess British Columbia family doctors' awareness of these costs.

[Document 3]
Six hundred family physicians.

[Document 4]
Governments are urged to determine methods to control the use of medical resources and curb the rise of healthcare costs. The question is, do health behaviors have an impact on the use of medical resources? This study aims to identify and understand the difference in the number of outpatient visits and health examinations based on various health behaviors and to determine whether patients seek medical care for illness from the same physicians.

[Document 5]
Family physician office practices in all regions of the United States.
